name: Chenille Barrel Swivel Accent Chair
summary: Linen chenille barrel armchair with a 360° swivel base, solid wood frame, and high-density foam. It ships fully assembled and is rated to support up to 350 pounds.
highlights: Solid wood frame with sinuous springs and elastic webbing
Linen chenille upholstery with high-density foam
Movable back cushion with a built-in wood support frame
Ships fully assembled; supports up to 350 lb
